messages:
Riley: quick heads-up — ran through the runtime onboarding checklist and hit a 500 when following the "setup env" shortlink (kb internal). Link: https://kb.internal/runtime/onboarding -> 500
Ava: ugh thanks for flagging. I noticed an erroring asset on that page earlier, might be the diagram CDN redirect 
Jun: can repro locally — looks like the onboarding diagram resolves to a staging URL that returns 403 now. quick curl: 
```
curl -I https://kb.internal/assets/onboarding-diagram.png
HTTP/2 403
```
Jun: I can open a tiny PR to rehost the image under the canonical assets bucket and update the shortlink if nobody else has it. should be a 2-line change.
Riley: tagging @Samira — you authored this originally, do you want to own the fix or should Jun make the PR? :eyes:
Samira: I wrote the first pass, thx for the ping. I lost write access to the asset bucket when we moved to prod. if Jun can do the PR and @me for review that's perfect.
Jun: ok will open PR in a few mins. patch will do `sed -i 's|https://staging-cdn.internal/|https://assets.kb.internal/|g' docs/runtime/onboarding.md` and add a note in the changelog.
docs-bot: created issue #4821 for kb scan (link: https://issues.internal/4821) — assigned to Jun.
Ava: thanks. ping me when PR's up and I'll run a quick smoke test against the onboarding flow. :thumbsup:
Jun: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4389 — includes image rehost + shortlink update. cc @Samira for review.
Riley: nice, leaving a quick review pass now. if all green we can merge and close the scan issue.
Samira: reviewed, left one nit about alt text. Jun can you apply and I'll approve?
Jun: done, pushed fix, updated PR. last test run showed the curl returns 200 now.
Riley: verified link works in prod preview. closing loop on this thread. :white_check_mark:
